Peter – I'm writing this from backstage at the Bing Crosby Theater in Spokane. In a few minutes, I walk out to face Michael Baumgartner for the first time since he became our Congressman.
Last cycle, he showed up late, mixed up state and federal leadership, and dodged every hard question on protecting access to reproductive care.
Tonight he has a record to answer for, and I intend to make him answer for it.
Here's what I'll say up there:
Eastern Washington deserves a leader who will fight to lower costs for families, farmers, and veterans; defend reproductive freedom; and work with anyone, from either party, to find common sense solutions to the challenges we share. That's the job. That's why I'm running.
Washington's 5th Congressional District deserves better than what it's getting.
Ballots drop in a matter of weeks. Between now and then, the GOP and its dark money allies will be watching tonight's debate and our next FEC report to decide whether this seat is really in play.
We have a chance to flip it for the first time in 30 years, but only if we can show real grassroots strength right now. Will you rush a donation right now?
[**https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cc-fr-2609**](https://us.list-manage.com/18GO2_aqdQ1?e=a7b299e420&c2id=1b040b68f1d062d0c966c24dae99fcb4)
If you're in Spokane, doors open at 6:00 p.m. and we start at 7:00. If you're anywhere else, or don’t already have tickets, watch live on KSPS PBS or [**The Spokesman-Review's YouTube page**](https://us.list-manage.com/9thecz2_En4?e=a7b299e420&c2id=1b040b68f1d062d0c966c24dae99fcb4). I'll see you out there.
Thank you. I'm honored to have your support.

clean_body: Doors open at 6, we go live at 7. I need you with me. | | | | | | | Peter – I'm writing this from backstage at the Bing Crosby Theater in Spokane. In a few minutes, I walk out to face Michael Baumgartner for the first time since he became our Congressman. Last cycle, he showed up late, mixed up state and federal leadership, and dodged every hard question on protecting access to reproductive care. Tonight he has a record to answer for, and I intend to make him answer for it. Here's what I'll say up there: Eastern Washington deserves a leader who will fight to lower costs for families, farmers, and veterans; defend reproductive freedom; and work with anyone, from either party, to find common sense solutions to the challenges we share. That's the job. That's why I'm running. Washington's 5th Congressional District deserves better than what it's getting. Ballots drop in a matter of weeks. Between now and then, the GOP and its dark money allies will be watching tonight's debate and our next FEC report to decide whether this seat is really in play. We have a chance to flip it for the first time in 30 years, but only if we can show real grassroots strength right now. Will you rush a donation right now? If you're in Spokane, doors open at 6:00 p.m. and we start at 7:00. If you're anywhere else, or don’t already have tickets, watch live on KSPS PBS or . I'll see you out there. Thank you. I'm honored to have your support. Speaker Johnson says he’s a Christian. _**I say he’s the Antichrist.**_

Senator Rafael Warnock called out Mike Johnson for his hypocrisy out loud. He said he couldn’t understand why the Speaker could read the bible, say a prayer, and then cut a trillion dollars out of Medicaid — calling it waste, fraud, and abuse.

My grandmother taught me in Sunday school that we are supposed to treat every single person that we meet with dignity.

**Speaker Mike Johnson? He wants to take healthcare away from millions of Americans. There’s nothing Christian about him. **
Mike Johnson thinks that he can hide behind his faith — but I know the truth.

He’s voted to cut Social Security. He tried to overturn the election in 2020. He has an extreme record on LGBTQ+ issues and bodily autonomy. And he’s used his Christian faith to explain his actions every step of the way.

**I’m the Democrat running against Mike Johnson because the gospel that was preached to me on Sunday mornings was that we should love our neighbor and treat them as our own. **

It's a damn shame that conservatives have co-opted Christian values while taking healthcare and SNAP benefits away from hardworking families like mine and yours. I’m working to change that:

name: Chris Pappas HQ
subject: the results are in
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Chris Pappas for Senate
body:
Only three Senate races in the country are rated Toss-up by Inside Elections. Ours is one of them.
# [](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/126?t=1&akid=8827%2E582294%2EoKi8NY)
Team,
**Last night New Hampshire chose Chris Pappas to be our Democratic nominee for the U.S. Senate.**
Thank you to everyone who knocked doors, made calls, and contributed what you could through emails like this one over the past year. **This happened because of you.**
We are officially in the general election, and we’re starting it in a position of strength.
_Now for the hard part._
Our opponent is John Sununu. He is a former U.S. Senator with the most recognizable last name in New Hampshire politics, and he will have every dollar national Republican groups can afford to send his way.
**Last week Inside Elections moved our race from Tilt Democratic to Toss-up.**
Here’s the current Senate map:
[](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260909_3.vb2uMq&refcode=em20260909-3&t=2&akid=8827%2E582294%2EoKi8NY)
Source: Inside Elections
**There are only three Toss-up Senate races in the entire country, and New Hampshire is one of them.**
Here’s why that matters: Republicans currently hold 53 seats in the Senate. For Democrats to win the majority, we need to net four seats. Democrats already hold New Hampshire’s Senate seat, so this isn’t a pickup opportunity — it’s a must-hold. If we lose it, Democrats would need five pickups instead of four, and the path gets very narrow very quickly.
There is no Democratic Senate majority without a win in New Hampshire.
**The general election started this morning.** We have 55 days to outwork and outcommunicate John Sununu, and the costs go up quickly from here: organizers in all ten counties of the state, TV and digital ads reserved before all the inventory evaporates, and the ability to answer every attack they lob at us.
That’s why we’re setting a critical goal: **raise $100,000 in the first 72 hours of the general election from emails like this one.**
**[Will you make your first general election contribution to Chris Pappas’s campaign today?](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260909_3.vb2uMq&refcode=em20260909-3&t=3&akid=8827%2E582294%2EoKi8NY)**
**[Give now to keep NH blue »](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260909_3.vb2uMq&refcode=em20260909-3&t=4&akid=8827%2E582294%2EoKi8NY)**
Let’s go win.
Chris Pappas HQ
P.S. John Sununu’s campaign and the outside groups backing him aren’t waiting for the dust to settle. If you can please give before midnight tonight to help us reach our $100,000 fundraising goal and start the general election on the front foot: **[https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em_ms_cp_20260909_3?refcode=em20260909-3&personal;=dpwillis67@gmail.com](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260909_3.vb2uMq&refcode=em20260909-3&t=5&akid=8827%2E582294%2EoKi8NY)**
_If you’ve donated recently, by check, or using a different email address, thank you! Our records take time to update, but thank you for the support!_
**New Hampshire is poised to be one of the closest Senate races in the country. Will you chip in today to help Chris stop the Republicans from flipping the Granite State red and expanding their Senate majority?**
**[Donate »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em_ms_cp_footer?refcode=em20260909-3&t=6&refcode2=8827_582294_oKi8NY&akid=8827%2E582294%2EoKi8NY)**
This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. Email is a critical way we communicate with grassroots supporters like you. However, if you would like to change your subscription preferences, here are some options:
* [Receive Fewer Emails](https://act.chrispappas.org/signup/cps_receive_fewer_emails/?t=7&akid=8827%2E582294%2EoKi8NY)
* [Update Your Information](https://act.chrispappas.org/signup/cps_update_your_information/?t=8&akid=8827%2E582294%2EoKi8NY)
* [Unsubscribe](https://act.chrispappas.org/unsubscribe/cps_unsubscribe/?t=9&akid=8827%2E582294%2EoKi8NY)
